name: Hertfordshire Zoo Conservation Grants
summary: Five one-year grants of up to GBP 1,000 for conservation projects run by organisations based in the range country of the species, landscape or ecosystem concerned.
reporting: A report at the end of the project year.

eligibility.rule: Be based in a species, landscape or ecosystem range country
Start no later than Oct 2026 and last no more than 12 months
Has not received this grant in the last two years

status.quote: The application period for the grant has now closed.

geography.quote: Hertfordshire Zoo is pleased to offer five short term grants for conservation projects around the world.
